label: NOTE: what this set reaches, and what it cannot
why: The fifteen members here were read out of .text+0x16ea0-0x17968 at one sitting and every entry below is a claim that disassembly makes: which state code each transition lands on, which of them clear symbolCount, which words of the CALLER'S V92CP are written, the guard each handler tests before it acts, the base of 24 exitCPt subtracts, and the six-symbol period generateRu indexes. THREE CLASSES OF CLAIM NEED SOMETHING THE FIXTURE HAD TO BE BUILT FOR. A store into the V92CP is invisible with one shared block, so t_v92p4gen gives each side its own and compares the two. The ARGUMENT to each `edprintf` is invisible in the object state, because the same path clears the count it prints, so the whole grid is run a second time at debug level 2 with the transcripts compared. And `flag_20` blocking a transition looks exactly like a transition that was never due, so the grid starts trials with it both set and clear. WHAT NO ENTRY HERE REACHES: the nine generators and setMappingParams, which are not written yet, and the ORDER of the stores inside resetBeforRRN and resetRRNSecondSection -- both write disjoint fields, so no observable separates one order from another.

NOTE: the six members added with V92CP::infoToBits
why: The six all end with the same four statements -- pack the CP message, take the vector, turn its padded length into a symbol count -- and the blob holds that block once per function with no helper symbol.  The entries that matter most change which byte goes into cp->byte_00 or divide by the wrong length, because the object comparison would pass on either if the grid never packed a message.  t_v92p4gen.cpp's 'some trial packed a CP message' is the counter that says it did, and it counts an OBSERVABLE outcome -- `pattern` landing inside the side's own V92CP -- rather than a source path.  recivedSUV and recivedPartTwoSilenceRrnSUV have the SAME body, so every anchor inside either has to carry its function's signature.  WHAT NO ENTRY REACHES: cp->bitsPerSymbol == 0 and cp->word_10c above six, both out of the fixture's grid, docs/deviations.md D570 and D571.
